user.title: Continue with ChatGPT
user.description: Run scripts/chatgpt_login.py on the computer running your browser. Sign in to ChatGPT and authorize plan usage, then paste the protected credential file JSON here. Use HTTPS to access Home Assistant. Credentials are saved locally by Home Assistant. See the installation guide for details.

model.title: Choose a ChatGPT model
model.description: Models come from your account. Device access starts disabled. Enable it later in the integration options.

error.invalid_auth: Credentials are invalid, expired, or lack ChatGPT plan permissions. Run the sign-in helper again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to OpenAI. Check internet access and try again.
error.no_models: No eligible models returned. Check ChatGPT account and workspace permissions.

abort.already_configured: This account registration is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same ChatGPT account and issued client ID.

settings.title: ChatGPT Assist options
settings.description:
Choose a model and capabilities. Expand the permission checklists to select targets. Direct automation updates and administrator log access are enabled by default; automation writes still require configuration access and a checked target. Dashboard changes require review. Select all/none refreshes the checklist on Submit; submit again to save.

{discovery_notice}

data.control: Allow reading and controlling exposed entities
data.logs_access: Allow administrator access to all available native logs

automations.name: Automations
automations.description: Select automation IDs. Duplicate IDs can be inspected and edited as individual entries. Existing blueprint inputs may be edited. Direct changes require an authenticated administrator; Select none clears reserved IDs too.

data.new_automation_ids: Reserve IDs for new automations (optional, comma separated)
data.automation_apply: Allow direct automation updates and restoration from chat

data_description.automation_apply: Enabled by default. Requested updates can save validated changes and reload automations without a separate approval dialog. Backups and conflict checks remain. Disable to require Configure review.

dashboards.name: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Choose existing storage-mode dashboards the assistant may inspect and draft changes for. YAML dashboards are unsupported. Saved unavailable grants remain visible for revocation.

sensors.name: Sensor history
sensors.description: Choose sensors whose recorded readings may be sent to ChatGPT. History requires Recorder and an authenticated user with entity read access. It grants no device control. Missing history cannot be recovered.

data_description.control: Uses Home Assistant Assist permissions and exposed entities. Device actions can execute without an extra confirmation.
data_description.administration: Allows selected configuration access. Automation changes may be applied directly from chat; dashboards always require review.
data_description.history_access: Allows read-only queries for checked history sensors, separately from device control. Requires an authenticated user.
data_description.web_search: Sends search queries to OpenAI’s hosted tool. Availability depends on the selected model and account.
data_description.logs_access: Includes Core errors/live/file logs, activity, automation/script traces and native Supervisor, app/plugin and host logs where available. Queried logs are sent to ChatGPT with best-effort credential redaction.

review.title: Select a configuration proposal
review.description: Select a draft to review, or select an applied/failed proposal and enable Restore to review its saved backup. Drafts expire after 30 minutes. Applying changes can affect your home.

data.rollback: Restore saved backup instead of applying the draft

confirm.title: Review configuration changes

data.approve: I have reviewed the configuration and approve this operation

alexa.title: Alexa voice bridge
alexa.description: Endpoint: your external HTTPS URL + {endpoint}. Enable the bridge, save, then open your skill on each Echo. Reopen these settings to pair the discovered Echo with its Alexa Media Player entity. Only signed requests from your configured skill and paired account/devices can generate replies. Voice requests use a fresh context and append to the selected user’s chat. Paired devices: {paired}. Saving the same device again changes its target. Disable the bridge to revoke all voice access. {failure}

data.user_id: Run and save voice questions as this HA user
data.target: Alexa Media Player target for this Echo
